sentences.text: Le lundi, Lucas passe deux heures à remplir de la paperasse pour la sécurité.
sentences.en: On Mondays, Lucas spends two hours filling in safety paperwork.
sentences.ko: 월요일마다 뤼카는 안전 관련 서류 작업에 두 시간을 써요.

sentences.text: Avant chaque tournage, Camille doit gérer une montagne de paperasse pour les autorisations.
sentences.en: Before each shoot, Camille has to handle a mountain of paperwork for the permits.
sentences.ko: 촬영할 때마다 카미유는 허가 서류를 산더미처럼 처리해야 해요.

sentences.text: L'usine a installé un nouveau logiciel de suivi, et Lucas apprend à s'en servir.
sentences.en: The factory has installed new tracking software, and Lucas is learning to use it.
sentences.ko: 공장에 새 관리 소프트웨어가 깔려서 뤼카가 사용법을 배우고 있어요.

sentences.text: Camille monte les scènes du jour avec un logiciel de montage sur son ordinateur.
sentences.en: Camille edits the day's scenes with editing software on her computer.
sentences.ko: 카미유는 그날 찍은 장면을 컴퓨터 편집 프로그램으로 편집해요.

sentences.text: Dans le hall de l'usine, Lucas montre un vieux télégramme encadré envoyé par le fondateur.
sentences.en: In the factory lobby, Lucas points out an old framed telegram sent by the founder.
sentences.ko: 공장 로비에서 뤼카는 창업자가 보낸 오래된 전보 액자를 보여 줘요.

sentences.text: Dans le film historique, Camille doit lire un télégramme devant la caméra.
sentences.en: In the period film, Camille has to read a telegram in front of the camera.
sentences.ko: 시대극에서 카미유는 카메라 앞에서 전보를 읽어야 해요.

sentences.text: Avant d'être ouvrier, le grand-père de Lucas était berger dans les Pyrénées.
sentences.en: Before becoming a factory worker, Lucas's grandfather was a shepherd in the Pyrenees.
sentences.ko: 뤼카의 할아버지는 공장 노동자가 되기 전에 피레네산맥에서 양치기였어요.

sentences.text: Pour la scène dans les montagnes, un vrai berger amène ses moutons, et Camille est ravie.
sentences.en: For the mountain scene, a real shepherd brings his sheep, and Camille is delighted.
sentences.ko: 산 장면에 진짜 양치기가 양 떼를 데려와서 카미유가 아주 기뻐해요.

sentences.text: Lucas doit calculer la quantité d'acier nécessaire pour la commande.
sentences.en: Lucas has to calculate how much steel the order needs.
sentences.ko: 뤼카는 주문에 필요한 강철 양을 계산해야 해요.

sentences.text: Camille aide le chef opérateur à calculer la distance entre la caméra et l'acteur.
sentences.en: Camille helps the director of photography calculate the distance between camera and actor.
sentences.ko: 카미유는 촬영 감독을 도와 카메라와 배우 사이 거리를 계산해요.

sentences.text: L'usine de Lucas va employer vingt personnes de plus à la rentrée.
sentences.en: Lucas's factory is going to take on twenty more people in September.
sentences.ko: 뤼카네 공장은 가을에 스무 명을 더 고용할 거예요.

sentences.text: La production va employer des figurants du village pour la scène du bal.
sentences.en: The production is going to use extras from the village for the ball scene.
sentences.ko: 제작진은 무도회 장면에 마을 주민들을 엑스트라로 쓸 거예요.

sentences.text: Les pièces fabriquées par Lucas finiront dans la combinaison d'un astronaute.
sentences.en: The parts Lucas makes will end up in an astronaut's suit.
sentences.ko: 뤼카가 만드는 부품은 우주 비행사의 우주복에 들어가요.

sentences.text: Camille joue une astronaute coincée sur une station spatiale.
sentences.en: Camille plays an astronaut stranded on a space station.
sentences.ko: 카미유는 우주 정거장에 갇힌 우주 비행사를 연기해요.

sentences.text: Lucas travaille dans le plus grand établissement industriel de la région.
sentences.en: Lucas works at the largest industrial site in the region.
sentences.ko: 뤼카는 지역에서 가장 큰 산업 시설에서 일해요.

sentences.text: L'équipe de Camille tourne dans un ancien établissement thermal.
sentences.en: Camille's crew is filming in a former spa establishment.
sentences.ko: 카미유의 팀은 옛 온천 시설에서 촬영해요.

sentences.text: L'usine de Lucas fabrique des pièces pour un réacteur d'avion.
sentences.en: Lucas's factory makes parts for an aircraft engine.
sentences.ko: 뤼카네 공장은 비행기 엔진 부품을 만들어요.

sentences.text: Dans la scène finale, Camille doit fuir avant que le réacteur de la base explose.
sentences.en: In the final scene, Camille has to escape before the base's reactor explodes.
sentences.ko: 마지막 장면에서 카미유는 기지의 원자로가 폭발하기 전에 도망쳐야 해요.

sentences.text: Un technicien vient réparer la presse sur laquelle travaille Lucas.
sentences.en: A technician comes to repair the press Lucas works on.
sentences.ko: 기술자가 와서 뤼카가 쓰는 프레스 기계를 고쳐요.

sentences.text: Le technicien du son demande à Camille de parler un peu plus fort.
sentences.en: The sound technician asks Camille to speak a little louder.
sentences.ko: 음향 기술자가 카미유에게 조금 더 크게 말해 달라고 해요.

sentences.text: Lucas doit classer les fiches de contrôle par date avant l'audit.
sentences.en: Lucas has to file the inspection sheets by date before the audit.
sentences.ko: 감사 전에 뤼카는 점검표를 날짜별로 정리해야 해요.

sentences.text: Camille aide la scripte à classer les prises de la journée.
sentences.en: Camille helps the script supervisor sort the day's takes.
sentences.ko: 카미유는 스크립터를 도와 그날 찍은 테이크를 정리해요.

sentences.text: Un concurrent vient d'ouvrir une usine à dix kilomètres de celle de Lucas.
sentences.en: A competitor has just opened a factory ten kilometres from Lucas's.
sentences.ko: 경쟁사가 뤼카네 공장에서 십 킬로미터 떨어진 곳에 공장을 막 열었어요.

sentences.text: Dans le film, Camille joue la concurrente d'un grand chef cuisinier.
sentences.en: In the film, Camille plays the rival of a great chef.
sentences.ko: 영화에서 카미유는 유명 셰프의 경쟁자를 연기해요.

sentences.text: Lucas fabrique aussi des moteurs pour les bateaux de pêcheur.
sentences.en: Lucas also makes engines for fishermen's boats.
sentences.ko: 뤼카는 어선용 엔진도 만들어요.

sentences.text: Pour son rôle, Camille passe une semaine sur le bateau d'un pêcheur breton.
sentences.en: For her role, Camille spends a week on a Breton fisherman's boat.
sentences.ko: 배역을 위해 카미유는 브르타뉴 어부의 배에서 일주일을 보내요.

sentences.text: L'usine de Lucas a failli faire faillite pendant la crise.
sentences.en: Lucas's factory almost went bankrupt during the crisis.
sentences.ko: 뤼카네 공장은 위기 때 파산할 뻔했어요.

sentences.text: Le personnage de Camille dirige une entreprise au bord de la faillite.
sentences.en: Camille's character runs a company on the verge of bankruptcy.
sentences.ko: 카미유가 맡은 인물은 파산 직전의 회사를 운영해요.

sentences.text: Le chef demande à Lucas de détourner la file des camions vers l'autre quai.
sentences.en: The boss asks Lucas to divert the line of lorries to the other dock.
sentences.ko: 반장이 뤼카에게 트럭 행렬을 다른 하역장으로 돌리라고 해요.

sentences.text: Un assistant essaie de détourner les passants pour que Camille puisse tourner tranquillement.
sentences.en: An assistant tries to steer passers-by away so that Camille can film in peace.
sentences.ko: 조수가 행인들을 다른 길로 돌려서 카미유가 편하게 촬영할 수 있게 해요.

sentences.text: Lucas doit désactiver l'alarme avant d'ouvrir l'atelier le matin.
sentences.en: Lucas has to switch off the alarm before opening the workshop in the morning.
sentences.ko: 뤼카는 아침에 작업장을 열기 전에 경보를 꺼야 해요.

sentences.text: Avant chaque prise, Camille pense à désactiver la sonnerie de son téléphone.
sentences.en: Before each take, Camille remembers to turn off her phone's ringer.
sentences.ko: 테이크마다 카미유는 휴대폰 벨소리를 끄는 걸 잊지 않아요.

sentences.text: Lucas apprend à détacher les pièces du moule sans les rayer.
sentences.en: Lucas is learning to detach the parts from the mould without scratching them.
sentences.ko: 뤼카는 부품을 긁지 않고 틀에서 떼어 내는 법을 배워요.

sentences.text: La costumière aide Camille à détacher sa longue robe entre deux scènes.
sentences.en: The costume designer helps Camille unfasten her long dress between scenes.
sentences.ko: 의상 담당이 장면 사이에 카미유의 긴 드레스를 풀어 줘요.

sentences.text: L'usine doit conserver chaque échantillon pendant cinq ans, rappelle Lucas.
sentences.en: The factory must keep every sample for five years, Lucas points out.
sentences.ko: 공장은 견본을 모두 오 년간 보관해야 한다고 뤼카가 상기시켜요.

sentences.text: Camille aime conserver un petit objet de chaque film qu'elle tourne.
sentences.en: Camille likes to keep a small object from every film she makes.
sentences.ko: 카미유는 찍은 영화마다 작은 소품 하나씩을 간직하는 걸 좋아해요.

sentences.text: Pendant la réunion, Lucas ose évoquer le problème des pauses trop courtes.
sentences.en: During the meeting, Lucas dares to raise the problem of breaks being too short.
sentences.ko: 회의에서 뤼카는 휴식 시간이 너무 짧다는 문제를 용기 내어 꺼내요.

sentences.text: Le réalisateur demande à Camille d'évoquer un souvenir triste pour pleurer.
sentences.en: The director asks Camille to recall a sad memory so she can cry.
sentences.ko: 감독은 카미유에게 울 수 있게 슬픈 기억을 떠올려 보라고 해요.

sentences.text: L'inspecteur arrive avec une mallette pleine d'instruments de mesure, observe Lucas.
sentences.en: The inspector arrives with a briefcase full of measuring instruments, Lucas observes.
sentences.ko: 검사관이 측정 기구가 가득 든 가방을 들고 온다고 뤼카가 지켜봐요.

sentences.text: Dans la scène du train, Camille vole une mallette remplie de billets.
sentences.en: In the train scene, Camille steals a briefcase full of banknotes.
sentences.ko: 기차 장면에서 카미유는 지폐가 가득 든 가방을 훔쳐요.

sentences.text: Le coéquipier de Lucas connaît la machine par cœur.
sentences.en: Lucas's teammate knows the machine inside out.
sentences.ko: 뤼카의 동료는 그 기계를 훤히 알아요.

sentences.text: Le partenaire de Camille dans le film joue son coéquipier de police.
sentences.en: Camille's co-star in the film plays her police partner.
sentences.ko: 영화에서 카미유의 상대 배우는 경찰 동료 역을 맡아요.

sentences.text: Lucas colle une étiquette bien visible sur chaque caisse.
sentences.en: Lucas sticks a clearly visible label on every crate.
sentences.ko: 뤼카는 상자마다 잘 보이는 라벨을 붙여요.

sentences.text: Le micro était visible dans le cadre, alors Camille rejoue la scène.
sentences.en: The microphone was visible in the frame, so Camille does the scene again.
sentences.ko: 마이크가 화면에 보여서 카미유는 장면을 다시 찍어요.

sentences.text: La cantine de l'usine est très animée à midi, et Lucas a du mal à trouver une place.
sentences.en: The factory canteen is very lively at noon, and Lucas struggles to find a seat.
sentences.ko: 정오에 공장 식당이 북적여서 뤼카는 자리 찾기가 힘들어요.

sentences.text: La rue est trop animée pour tourner, et Camille attend le soir.
sentences.en: The street is too busy to film in, so Camille waits for the evening.
sentences.ko: 거리가 너무 북적여서 카미유는 저녁까지 기다려요.

sentences.text: Lucas a suivi une formation en maintenance mécanique.
sentences.en: Lucas trained in mechanical maintenance.
sentences.ko: 뤼카는 기계 정비 교육을 받았어요.

sentences.text: Camille doit monter sur un taureau mécanique pour une scène comique.
sentences.en: Camille has to ride a mechanical bull for a comic scene.
sentences.ko: 카미유는 코믹한 장면을 위해 기계 황소를 타야 해요.

sentences.text: Avant d'entrer dans l'atelier, Lucas doit enfiler une blouse et des gants.
sentences.en: Before entering the workshop, Lucas has to put on a coat and gloves.
sentences.ko: 작업장에 들어가기 전에 뤼카는 작업복과 장갑을 껴야 해요.

sentences.text: Camille a quelques secondes pour enfiler son manteau entre les deux plans.
sentences.en: Camille has a few seconds to slip on her coat between the two shots.
sentences.ko: 두 컷 사이에 카미유가 코트를 걸칠 시간은 몇 초밖에 없어요.

sentences.text: Lucas entend un bruit anormal dans le moteur et arrête la chaîne.
sentences.en: Lucas hears an abnormal noise in the motor and stops the line.
sentences.ko: 뤼카는 모터에서 이상한 소리를 듣고 생산 라인을 멈춰요.

sentences.text: Il fait un froid anormal pour un mois de juin, et Camille grelotte en robe d'été.
sentences.en: It's abnormally cold for June, and Camille is shivering in her summer dress.
sentences.ko: 6월치고 이상하게 추워서 카미유는 여름 원피스 차림으로 떨어요.

sentences.text: La direction va dévoiler le nouveau modèle devant Lucas et ses collègues.
sentences.en: Management is going to unveil the new model in front of Lucas and his colleagues.
sentences.ko: 경영진이 뤼카와 동료들 앞에서 새 모델을 공개할 거예요.

sentences.text: Camille n'a pas le droit de dévoiler la fin du film aux journalistes.
sentences.en: Camille isn't allowed to reveal the ending of the film to journalists.
sentences.ko: 카미유는 기자들에게 영화 결말을 밝히면 안 돼요.

sentences.text: Lucas s'apprête à partir quand une machine tombe en panne.
sentences.en: Lucas is about to leave when a machine breaks down.
sentences.ko: 뤼카가 막 퇴근하려는데 기계가 고장 나요.

sentences.text: Camille s'apprête à entrer en scène quand la pluie se met à tomber.
sentences.en: Camille is getting ready to go on set when it starts to rain.
sentences.ko: 카미유가 막 촬영에 들어가려는데 비가 내리기 시작해요.

sentences.text: Une entreprise étrangère s'est emparée du marché, et Lucas craint pour son poste.
sentences.en: A foreign company has taken over the market, and Lucas fears for his job.
sentences.ko: 외국 기업이 시장을 차지해서 뤼카는 자기 자리가 걱정돼요.

sentences.text: Dans la scène d'action, Camille s'empare d'une épée en plastique.
sentences.en: In the action scene, Camille grabs a plastic sword.
sentences.ko: 액션 장면에서 카미유는 플라스틱 칼을 집어 들어요.

sentences.text: La sirène se met à siffler à midi pile, et Lucas part déjeuner.
sentences.en: The siren starts whistling at noon on the dot, and Lucas goes for lunch.
sentences.ko: 정오가 되자 사이렌이 울리고 뤼카는 점심을 먹으러 가요.

sentences.text: Le réalisateur fait siffler son assistant pour signaler la fin de la prise, explique Camille.
sentences.en: The director has his assistant blow a whistle to signal the end of the take, Camille explains.
sentences.ko: 감독이 조수에게 호루라기를 불게 해서 테이크 끝을 알린다고 카미유가 설명해요.

sentences.text: Le chef d'atelier doit évaluer le travail de Lucas avant les vacances.
sentences.en: The workshop manager has to assess Lucas's work before the holidays.
sentences.ko: 작업반장은 휴가 전에 뤼카의 업무를 평가해야 해요.

sentences.text: La productrice vient évaluer les décors avant que Camille arrive.
sentences.en: The producer comes to assess the sets before Camille arrives.
sentences.ko: 프로듀서가 카미유가 오기 전에 세트를 점검하러 와요.

sentences.text: Lucas déplace un bloc d'acier massif avec le pont roulant.
sentences.en: Lucas moves a massive block of steel with the overhead crane.
sentences.ko: 뤼카는 천장 크레인으로 거대한 강철 덩어리를 옮겨요.

sentences.text: Le château choisi pour le film est massif et impressionne Camille.
sentences.en: The château chosen for the film is massive and impresses Camille.
sentences.ko: 영화에 쓸 성은 웅장해서 카미유가 감탄해요.

sentences.text: L'apprenti est futé : il a trouvé tout seul comment gagner du temps, admire Lucas.
sentences.en: The apprentice is clever: he worked out how to save time on his own, Lucas admires.
sentences.ko: 견습생이 영리해서 혼자 시간 아끼는 법을 찾아냈다고 뤼카가 감탄해요.

sentences.text: Dans ce film, Camille interprète une détective futée qui piège les voleurs.
sentences.en: In this film, Camille plays a sharp detective who traps thieves.
sentences.ko: 이 영화에서 카미유는 도둑들을 함정에 빠뜨리는 영리한 탐정을 연기해요.

sentences.text: L'équipe de nuit est composée de jeunes ouvriers, explique Lucas.
sentences.en: The night shift is made up of young workers, Lucas explains.
sentences.ko: 야간 조는 젊은 노동자들로 이루어져 있다고 뤼카가 설명해요.

sentences.text: L'équipe technique est composée de dix personnes, précise Camille.
sentences.en: The technical crew is made up of ten people, Camille specifies.
sentences.ko: 기술팀은 열 명으로 이루어져 있다고 카미유가 밝혀요.

sentences.text: Lucas a dû bourrer les cartons de papier journal pour protéger les pièces.
sentences.en: Lucas had to stuff the boxes with newspaper to protect the parts.
sentences.ko: 뤼카는 부품을 보호하려고 상자에 신문지를 꽉 채워 넣어야 했어요.

sentences.text: La costumière doit bourrer les épaules de la veste pour Camille.
sentences.en: The costume designer has to pad the shoulders of the jacket for Camille.
sentences.ko: 의상 담당이 카미유의 재킷 어깨에 솜을 채워 넣어야 해요.

sentences.text: Sur le formulaire, Lucas écrit « soudeur » à la ligne profession.
sentences.en: On the form, Lucas writes "welder" on the occupation line.
sentences.ko: 뤼카는 서류의 직업란에 "용접공"이라고 적어요.

sentences.text: Camille a choisi sa profession d'actrice à quinze ans.
sentences.en: Camille chose her profession as an actress at fifteen.
sentences.ko: 카미유는 열다섯 살에 배우를 직업으로 정했어요.

sentences.text: Le portrait du fondateur est accroché dans le bureau où Lucas pointe.
sentences.en: The founder's portrait hangs in the office where Lucas clocks in.
sentences.ko: 뤼카가 출근 도장을 찍는 사무실에 창업자 초상화가 걸려 있어요.

sentences.text: Le fondateur du festival vient saluer Camille sur le tournage.
sentences.en: The festival's founder comes to greet Camille on set.
sentences.ko: 영화제 창립자가 촬영장에 와서 카미유에게 인사해요.

sentences.text: Dans la pièce de théâtre de l'usine, Lucas joue le rôle d'un valet maladroit.
sentences.en: In the factory's play, Lucas plays the part of a clumsy valet.
sentences.ko: 공장 연극에서 뤼카는 서툰 하인 역을 맡아요.

sentences.text: Dans le film d'époque, un valet apporte le thé à Camille.
sentences.en: In the period film, a valet brings Camille her tea.
sentences.ko: 시대극에서 하인이 카미유에게 차를 가져다줘요.

sentences.text: Lucas fait une démonstration de la nouvelle machine aux visiteurs.
sentences.en: Lucas gives the visitors a demonstration of the new machine.
sentences.ko: 뤼카는 방문객들에게 새 기계를 시연해 보여요.

sentences.text: Le cascadeur fait une démonstration de la chute à Camille.
sentences.en: The stuntman demonstrates the fall for Camille.
sentences.ko: 스턴트맨이 카미유에게 넘어지는 동작을 시범으로 보여 줘요.

sentences.text: Le contrôleur demande à Lucas de corriger un réglage sur la ligne trois.
sentences.en: The inspector asks Lucas to correct a setting on line three.
sentences.ko: 검사원이 뤼카에게 3번 라인의 설정을 바로잡으라고 해요.

sentences.text: La maquilleuse doit corriger le rouge à lèvres de Camille entre deux prises.
sentences.en: The make-up artist has to fix Camille's lipstick between takes.
sentences.ko: 분장사가 테이크 사이에 카미유의 립스틱을 고쳐야 해요.
